researchRecords.question: What skill levels, stigmas and built-in macro chains should a level-36 Cleric on the global client run, for leveling and PvE, and how is the built-in macro editor's priority ordered?
researchRecords.lede: Solo: damage first, Light of Protection → Earth Punishment → Noble Aura. Dungeons: heals to 10, Light of Protection, Resurrection.
researchRecords.caveat: Macro entries are single skills (read in game); their run order, top-down or bottom-up, is still unconfirmed.

researchRecords.question: Where does the official Aion 2 site publish a character's public data, so pnpm sync can fetch it without game input?
researchRecords.lede: aion2.plaync.com serves any character as JSON, no login: search by name, then info + equipment by server and id.
researchRecords.caveat: Undocumented endpoints; NC's Open API has nothing for Aion 2 and its Terms forbid other automated access. Macros and keybinds are not published.

researchRecords.question: Which skill levels, stigmas and built-in macro chain make a level-38 global Cleric a damage-first dungeon player that heals the party on the side?
researchRecords.lede: Dungeon DPS Cleric: damage skills to 10, heals to 8; Light of Protection, Earth Punishment, Noble Aura, Prayer of Amplification.
researchRecords.caveat: Theory until played: guides split on the fourth stigma, Debilitating Mark and whether a macro entry fires a whole hotbar column.

skills.name: Immortal Veil

mechanics.title: Hotbar column: the bottom skill is tried first
mechanics.body: Each hotbar key holds a column of up to 4 skills; a press tries the bottom one, then moves up past anything on cooldown or unusable.

mechanics.title: Conflict: what sits at the bottom of a column
mechanics.body: Cooldown skills at the bottom, filler on top (mein-mmo, playnews). allthings.how says both: no-cooldown attack at the bottom, and zero-cooldown skills high.

mechanics.title: A macro entry is one skill, not a hotbar column
mechanics.body: Read in the global client: each entry holds one skill and its own delay. Settles the conflict: allthings.how and playnews said whole columns; the KR frame showed single skills.

mechanics.title: Conflict: the order the editor runs its entries
mechanics.body: Likely top to bottom (allthings.how); the editor's top-down numbering fits it. mein-mmo's 'bottom up' may mean the column. Not yet seen in game.

mechanics.title: The editor numbers its entries from the top
mechanics.body: Entries run 1, 2, 3… downward, each with a trash can; Add Macro appends an Earth's Retribution entry below. Display order, not run order.

mechanics.title: Conflict: the basic attack inside the macro
mechanics.body: KR Clerics interleave Earth's Retribution entries (Inven, a May 2026 video); mein-mmo and playnews keep it out and hold left click. Verdict on PC: keep it out.

mechanics.title: How long a chain can be
mechanics.body: A hotbar key holds rows 0–3, so 4 skills (read in game, as playnews says). Entries per macro: up to 20 (allthings.how), not yet seen in game.

mechanics.title: Bind the macro key first; hold it to run
mechanics.body: Unbound by default: Settings > Key Settings > General > Gameplay > Macro. Hold, don't tap; any manual input takes priority over the running macro.

mechanics.title: Delay: 10 ms, raise only if skills drop
mechanics.body: Each entry has a delay; the default fell from 50 to 10 ms (10 in the global client). Try 40–50 ms only if skills fail to fire. It is input spacing, not ping.

mechanics.title: Keep toggles, charged skills and long cooldowns out
mechanics.body: A loop switches a toggle off (Light of Protection) and fires charged skills at charge 1 (Bolt); 45–60 s skills stall a fast loop.

mechanics.title: Hold the basic attack beside the macro
mechanics.body: Hold left click with the macro key: basic attacks cancel animations and restore MP. Whether it also belongs inside the macro is its own conflict entry.

mechanics.title: Each skill preset has its own macro
mechanics.body: Presets 1–3 each keep a macro, so a solo preset and a dungeon preset can carry different chains.

mechanics.title: Stigma slots on global: 22, 27, 32, 37
mechanics.body: Four slots at levels 22, 27, 32 and 37; stigma level cap 20; stigma points start at 23 and reach about 14 by level 36.

mechanics.title: Conflict: Korea's and Taiwan's stigma slot count
mechanics.body: Global has 4. KR went to 5 on 2026-03-25 (aion2hub), 6 at level 50 (aion2.run); allthings.how says Taiwan has 6. Don't copy KR stigma sets.

mechanics.title: Skill points: 21 to reach level 10
mechanics.body: Level 1 is free; levels 2–4 cost 1, 5–7 cost 2, 8–10 cost 4. 203 points by 45 (about 147 at 36); Wisdom Stones add more.

mechanics.title: Specializations at skill levels 8, 12, 16 and 20
mechanics.body: A skill at 10 holds one pick from its level-8 options; slots open at 8, 12 and 20. Past 10 only Daevanion, gear and Arcana raise a skill.

mechanics.title: Skill level gate: one level per 3 character levels
mechanics.body: A skill gains at most one level every 3 character levels; at 36 that holds Bolt (learned at 14) at 8, and aion2maps' plan has it at 10 by 38.

mechanics.title: Condemnation needs Chain of Torment; Earth Punishment makes it crit
mechanics.body: Condemnation hits only Chain of Torment targets; Earth Punishment level 5 makes it crit. Cooldown-free only at Condemnation 12 (Daevanion or gear past 10).

mechanics.title: Light of Protection and Chain of Torment overlap with a Chanter
mechanics.body: Light of Protection doesn't stack with Undefeated Mantra; Chain of Torment doesn't apply with Earth's Promise. With a Chanter, swap Light of Protection for Absolution.

mechanics.title: Conflict: the first solo stigma
mechanics.body: Light of Protection at 22 (metabot and aion2.run, the client-data sources) vs Earth Punishment first (eloboost24, on paper). Verdict: Light of Protection, Earth Punishment at 27.

mechanics.title: Conflict: Resurrection or Noble Aura in group stigmas
mechanics.body: Top level-45 Clerics favour Noble Aura (79%) over Summon Resurrection (64%); keengamer keeps Resurrection until mechanics are clean. Verdict: Resurrection first at 32–36.

mechanics.title: Conflict: heals or damage first in skill points
mechanics.body: eloboost24 levels Healing Light and Radiant Recovery first; aion2.run keeps heals at 1 until 34 while leveling. Verdict: damage first solo, heals first for dungeons.

mechanics.title: Chests need the Cleric's damage too
mechanics.body: Dungeon chest contribution counts damage (about 5% of the boss's HP) or healing; a Cleric who only heals can leave with nothing.

mechanics.title: Korean guides run a later version
mechanics.body: KR: level 50, stigma level 25, extra slots, a ninth class, a reworked macro (May 2026). Use KR guides for class logic, not numbers.

mechanics.title: Lookup: search by name, then fetch by server and character id
mechanics.body: GET api-search.plaync.com/aion2global/search/v2/character?keyword=&region=&localeInfo= (optional serverId) returns characterId, serverId, pcId, level. Both params required: 400 without localeInfo.

mechanics.title: Character info: profile, stats, item level, titles, Daevanion
mechanics.body: GET aion2.plaync.com/api/character/info?region=&lang=&characterId=&serverId=. profile has name, className, characterLevel, combatPower, serverName; item level is the stat row of type ItemLevel. 404 without region.

mechanics.title: Character equipment: gear, skills with levels, stigmas
mechanics.body: GET aion2.plaync.com/api/character/equipment, same params. skill.skillList has every class skill: category Active, Passive or Dp (stigma), skillLevel, acquired, equip. Stigmas carry no slot position.

mechanics.title: No auth, no cookies, no rate-limit headers seen
mechanics.body: Plain curl with its default User-Agent gets 200 and no Set-Cookie. 20 back-to-back info calls all answered 200; responses are no-store, live calls take about 1.8 s and repeats inside a few seconds about 0.24 s.

mechanics.title: Errors: unknown id, wrong server and missing region are all 404
mechanics.body: info answers 404 application/problem+json with code resource.not_found for a wrong serverId, an unknown characterId and a missing region alike, so a 404 does not say which.

mechanics.title: Terms of Use forbid automated access outside published interfaces
mechanics.body: NC's Terms § 6, linked from the profile page's footer, bar automated access other than published interfaces, and scraping without consent. The character endpoints are unpublished; a scheduled fetch runs against that.

mechanics.title: NC's published Open API has no Aion 2 character data
mechanics.body: The NC OPEN API at developers.plaync.com documents Lineage 2M market data only, needs a key, and forbids caching its data; /apis/aion2 lands on an error page. Nothing published covers Aion 2, global or KR.

mechanics.title: Name search is case-insensitive: match case-sensitively, by server
mechanics.body: The search returns substring matches in any case with <strong> markup ("BAon" for "Baon"). Strip the markup, keep the configured serverId, compare the name exactly; info accepts the id with %3D or =.

mechanics.title: Fan armory: no public API
mechanics.body: metabot.gg reads the same official data and refreshes a copy older than 30 minutes, but its /api/ is disallowed in robots.txt, answers curl with 403 and has no developer page.

mechanics.title: Condemnation is the damage engine
mechanics.body: Hits only Chain of Torment targets; Earth Punishment at stigma 5 makes it always crit; at skill 12 a crit resets its cooldown. Half the damage on a KR meter.

mechanics.title: A damage Cleric still owes the chest contribution
mechanics.body: Chest needs 5% of the final boss's HP in damage or 20% of party damage healed (aion2.run, citing GamersTogether); a pure healer can leave with nothing.

mechanics.title: Light of Protection doesn't stack with Undefeated Mantra
mechanics.body: Only the stronger applies and the Chanter's Mantra wins a tie; with a Chanter in the group, slot Absolution instead.

mechanics.title: Conflict: the fourth stigma for a damage Cleric
mechanics.body: Prayer of Amplification (expcarry, playhub, aion2maps, aion2.run offensive) against Summon Resurrection (64% of top Clerics vs 50%) or Yustiel's Power (Antochi).

mechanics.title: Conflict: Debilitating Mark in the damage loop
mechanics.body: In the macro per playhub and expcarry, and a global dummy tester gains with it; Antochi and KR ranker data call casting it on cooldown a damage loss.

mechanics.title: Conflict: does a macro entry fire a whole hotbar column?
mechanics.body: Creators stack skills in one column and register only its row-0 skill (Antochi: 'one step, that column'); the 2026-10-10 in-game read took an entry as one skill.

mechanics.title: Conflict: Bolt inside the macro
mechanics.body: Th3Ruthless registers Bolt as an entry; Antochi, allthings.how and a BoredAF commenter keep it manual, since the macro fires it at charge 1.

mechanics.title: Repeat Condemnation once the reset is live
mechanics.body: Expcarry lists Condemnation several times in its boss macro to catch crit resets; worth it only once Condemnation reaches 12 with the reset spec.

mechanics.title: Turn Skill Queue off for the Condemnation macro
mechanics.body: BoredAF: with Skill Queue on, Condemnation doesn't go out properly; Antochi and expcarry say turn it on. Test both on the dummy.

timeline.event: KR: skill macro added (per-step delays, hold to run); Earth Punishment cooldown 60 → 30 s.
KR: stigma slots raised to 5 and a new Cleric stigma, Touch of Rebirth, not in the global client.
KR: the in-game skill macro is reworked; Korean Cleric macro videos from here on use the new editor.
KR: healing rework; Cleric heals reach 40 m, heal less, and scale with Attack.
KR: Bolt +20% PvE damage; Prayer of Amplification rebuilt.
Global launch: level 45 cap, 4 stigma slots at 22/27/32/37, stigma level 20.
First global Cleric and macro guides published (eloboost24, keengamer, playnews, mein-mmo).
Global client read in game: the macro editor takes one skill per entry, 10 ms default delay.
KR: support party synergy softened; Earth Punishment's party share cut to 5%, Prayer of Amplification and Earth's Grace raised.
Global: first hybrid Cleric builds pair Light of Protection with Earth Punishment, Noble Aura and Prayer of Amplification.
Global: expcarry and playhub publish the damage-leaning boss healer; gamerblurb keeps a stigma set with no damage slot.
Global: Antochi maps the Korean Condemnation macro onto global's four stigma slots.

takeaways.text: Solo: Condemnation, Chain of Torment, Earth's Retribution, Judgment Thunder, Divine Aura and Bolt to 10, damage before heals.
takeaways.detail: At 36 (about 147 points): those at 10 with Bolt at 8, Debilitating Mark 8, the rest in Healing Light.

takeaways.text: Solo stigmas: Light of Protection, Earth Punishment, Noble Aura now; Prayer of Amplification at 37.
takeaways.detail: Earth Punishment level 5 makes Condemnation crit; the cooldown reset also needs Condemnation at 12.

takeaways.text: Dungeons: heals to 10 first, Light of Protection and Earth Punishment, Summon Resurrection until the group stops dying.
takeaways.detail: Swap Light of Protection for Absolution when a Chanter brings Undefeated Mantra.

takeaways.text: Macro: one skill per entry, cooldowns first, Judgment Thunder last, 10 ms each; bind it and hold it with left click.
takeaways.detail: Read in the global client: an entry holds one skill and its own delay, numbered from the top.

takeaways.text: Never macro Light of Protection or Bolt: the loop turns the toggle off and fires Bolt uncharged.
Unconfirmed: whether the editor runs its entries top-down or bottom-up. Check in game before trusting step order.
takeaways.detail: allthings.how says top to bottom; mein-mmo's 'bottom up' may describe the column instead.

takeaways.text: Korean guides assume 5–6 stigma slots and level 50: take their logic, not their numbers.
The official site serves any character as JSON without login: sync can read level, gear, skills and stigmas.
takeaways.detail: Search by name and region, then info and equipment by serverId and characterId on aion2.plaync.com.

takeaways.text: The character is Baon on Fafnir (EU, serverId 2319), Asmodian Cleric, level 36.
takeaways.detail: The only level-36 Cleric named Baon in any global region's search on 2026-10-10.

takeaways.text: Macros, keybinds and stigma slot positions are not published: those still come from the game read.
No published NC API covers Aion 2, and the Terms forbid automated access elsewhere: keep sync on demand, decide the daily job.
takeaways.detail: NC's Open API documents Lineage 2M only. The scheduled GitHub Actions sync is the part the Terms bear on most.

takeaways.text: Dungeon DPS Cleric: Condemnation, Chain of Torment, Earth's Retribution, Divine Aura, Bolt, Judgment Thunder to 10; heals to 8.
takeaways.detail: Then Empyrean Lord's Grace and Earth's Grace to 10; Debilitating Mark last and contested.

takeaways.text: Stigmas: Light of Protection, Earth Punishment, Noble Aura, Prayer of Amplification; Earth Punishment to 5 first.
takeaways.detail: Summon Resurrection for Prayer while the group dies; Absolution for Light of Protection with a Chanter.

takeaways.text: Macro: Earth Punishment, Chain of Torment, Condemnation, Divine Aura, Light of Regeneration, Debilitating Mark, Judgment Thunder.
takeaways.detail: Right mouse held with left click, 10 ms; Bolt, Healing Light, Radiant Recovery and the stigmas stay manual.

takeaways.text: Heal by hand first, then return to the loop: the macro's only heal is Light of Regeneration.
Unsettled: whether an entry fires its hotbar column. Put each macro skill on its own key and it works either way.
takeaways.detail: Creators stack columns behind one entry; the 2026-10-10 read took an entry as one skill.
